record.question: Digital mammography detector is usually:
record.explanation: Answer B: Amorphous selenium direct detector. Among the offered choices, direct digital mammography may use an amorphous-selenium detector; detector technology varies and indirect scintillator systems also exist. Source/context note: Detector construction is vendor/system-dependent; digital mammography also uses indirect-conversion detectors. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mammo; https://www.dicomstandard.org/current. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
